supporting_observations.claim: WS-RDIAZ-01 made repeated connections to the internal proxy at 10.56.20.30:8080 during the review window; the records identify the service as HTTP. Examples include connections at 13:38:37, 13:46:01, 13:51:16, 13:56:22, 14:00:07, 14:05:39, and 14:10:38 UTC.

Some observed proxy-connection times are about five minutes apart, but the recorded sequence is not consistently five-minute periodic: for example, connections occur at 13:38:37 and 13:40:56, then 13:46:01 and 13:51:16 UTC.

The records establish connections to the internal proxy, but do not identify the external destination or the originating application, so they do not establish that the traffic was the approved GradeBook Pro updater or that it was malicious.
